subject: Service restitution & impact verification — token loss observed on checkout path
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@cartwheel.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: support@cartwheel.com
Date: Tue, 09 Oct 2029 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: checkout failures / token loss — urgent verification and credit request

Hi Michael,

We saw a sharp spike of checkout failures this morning between 06:12:14 and 06:22:05 UTC (UTC timestamp shown in our logs). Users started getting 5xx responses and several orders failed to complete. Our SRE pulled one sample trace and attached it here (cartwheel_error_snapshot.log).

Symptoms: 80% of failed requests returned a short response (partial token stream) then a 524 gateway timeout from our edge. This looks like tokenization/kV cache mismatch — some requests appear to have truncated responses. Total impacted orders ~1,200 in the 10 minute window; peak concurrency ~1,400.

Can you confirm whether this counts against the SLA (availability/latency) and advise next steps for evidence gathering and credits? We need:
- confirmation of the service availability window from Redwood's side
- a bailiff-style packet/trace bundle we can reference in our postmortem
- an initial estimate of any pro rata credit we should expect per our contract (see clause 4.2)

We can share more traces if helpful. Attaching one example (cartwheel_error_snapshot.log).

Thanks — this is high-priority for the account team.

Alex Moreno
Head of Engineering
Cartwheel Commerce
alex@cartwheel.com
+1 (415) 555-0183
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.ai, Alex Moreno <alex@cartwheel.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Oct 2029 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: checkout failures / token loss — urgent verification and credit request

Laura / Diego — forwarding the customer report from Cartwheel. Quick asks:

1) Can the IR team confirm whether there was a regional availability/latency SLO breach for the US checkout path in the 06:10–06:25 UTC window? If so, capture the start/end and severity.
2) Pull traces + raw agent logs for the Nginx/gateway layer and the tokenization service (svc-tokenize) for the window; include request IDs. Alex attached a sample snapshot; we should match the request IDs if possible.
3) If this qualifies for a credit under the contract, I need an initial compensation number we can communicate back. The customer is asking for a pro rata estimate.

Please prioritize and let me know ETA for the evidence bundle. I'll coordinate with Alex on what they can share.

--
Michael Grant
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@cartwheel.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Oct 2029 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: checkout failures / token loss — urgent verification and credit request

Hi Alex — thanks for the sample and the heads-up. We appreciate the detail.

Initial summary from our side (preliminary):
- We see a short-lived spike in error rates that correlates with a partial KV-cache eviction in the tokenizer tier in us-west-2. The service remained reachable but a subset of requests returned truncated token sequences before timing out (appears consistent with the behavior you described).
- We're classifying this as a service availability impact candidate for SLA review; Diego's team is compiling a raw trace bundle and will include the gateway logs, tokenizer process logs, and the auto-scaler metric dumps.

Attachments/links: governance-checklist.pdf (attached) outlines the data we will include and privacy steps; we also uploaded the initial trace bundle here: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/checkout-traces

Next steps I propose:
- Diego to publish the extracted trace bundle and timeline within 6 hours.
- We will run the SLA eligibility calculation based on clause 4.2 and share a provisional credit estimate within 12 hours.
- Formal postmortem and remediation items will be delivered in 48 hours (we will invite your SRE).

Can you confirm whether Cartwheel needs a formal DPA/data release for us to share full request bodies? We may be able to redact token payloads but need permission for that scope.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Manager — Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, michael_grant@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex@cartwheel.com>, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 09 Oct 2029 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: checkout failures / token loss — urgent verification and credit request

On Tue, 09 Oct 2029 10:18:00 -0700 Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Alex — thanks for the sample and the heads-up. We appreciate the detail.
>
> Initial summary from our side (preliminary):
> - We see a short-lived spike in error rates that correlates with a partial KV-cache eviction in the tokenizer tier in us-west-2. The service remained reachable but a subset of requests returned truncated token sequences before timing out (appears consistent with the behavior you described).

Folks — technical addendum: we confirmed an autoscaler race during a rolling node replacement that produced a small window where the tokenizer instances were under-provisioned for a sudden concurrency spike. The KV cache warmed slowly for a subset of shards; that produced truncated early responses for requests that hit a cold shard and then timed out on upstream reads.

Deliverables we will produce in the evidence bundle:
- gateway-nginx.log (06:05:00–06:30:00 UTC) — includes request IDs matching Alex's sample
- svc-tokenize stdout/stderr fragments (rotated) for impacted hosts
- k8s events and autoscaler traces for the node-replacement activity
- timeline.csv with aligned UTC timestamps and a brief description of each event

Per contract clause 4.2 (availability remedies) we will compute a provisional pro rata credit. Accounting will need the final time window; for now our internal estimate (subject to review) is ~3.5% of monthly committed invoice for the impacted interval.

I'm starting the postmortem draft and will share the initial RCA and mitigation items within 48 hours. Finance, please prepare an adjustment route for DEAL-47821 if the SLA calculation holds.

--
Diego Fernandez
Incident Response Lead, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
